title: MV YEP Actor Party Switch dead actor switching add-on?

posts.author: Twig_the_Blue_Pikmin
posts.body:
Im looking for a way to make it so that Actors that are dead can still use the Switch command provided by YEP's Actor Party Switch plugin, thus allowing them to switch themselves out and also be switched in.
I dont know if it's possible to make this work though like through an add-on or something? I just thought I'd see if anyone knew how to get this to work
Basically I want the plugin to work with dead actors similar to how Super Mario RPG does it pictured below

posts.author: rpgLord69
posts.body:
So you need dead dudes to take turns? Maybe give them a state that makes them immortal and then put state motion dead on that state. Also group defeat notetag or whatever it was so it's game over if all have it. Then make it seal everything, except skip attack skill for pass skill that does nothing. And then you can go to the party command window to swap the formation. If you want to make it fancy, maybe edit it so that the actor command window shows the formation command and only that in addition to the skip skill. LOL.
EDIT: Got a bit confused with party system and actor party switch, but still I think the idea behind what I wrote could work.
